papers.title: A Survey of Robotic Navigation and Manipulation with Physics Simulators in the Era of Embodied AI
papers.summary: Navigation and manipulation are core capabilities in Embodied AI, but training agents to perform them directly in the real world is costly, time-consuming, and unsafe. Therefore, sim-to-real transfer has emerged as a key approach, yet the sim-to-real gap persists. This survey examines how physics simulators address this gap by analyzing properties that have received limited attention in prior surveys. papers.title: Schatting en tracking van de 6D-pose van objecten voor robotwaarneming
papers.summary: Estimating the 6D pose of objects, comprising both 3D position and orientation, is a key requirement for many robotic applications. It enables robots to perceive and interact intelligently with the physical environment, supporting tasks in human-robot collaboration, logistics automation, and industrial operations. In human-robot collaborative assembly settings, accurate and continuous 6D pose tracking of product parts is essential for precise grasping and placement. papers.summary: Abstract Automated harvesting is pivotal to smart agriculture, yet precisely localizing picking points in complex orchard environments remains a key challenge for robotic harvesting systems. papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Design for Enhanced Performance and Energy Efficiency in Computer Architecture
papers.summary: This research journal discusses how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) can enhance computer architecture design by addressing challenges in performance and energy efficiency. Traditional methods rely on expert intuition and exhaustive simulations, which are limited when exploring vast design spaces.
